en-US.title: Pulpo
en-US.subtitle: Your AI workspace, anywhere
en-US.description:
Pulpo is the native iPhone client for Pulpo AI workspaces. Connect securely to pulpo.baby or your own compatible Pulpo instance, continue conversations in real time, manage folders and branches, work with files, and keep useful drafts and history available on your device.

Pulpo supports model presets, reasoning controls, agent activity, response streaming and cancellation, public sharing, offline-safe organization changes, local full-text search, and native iOS accessibility preferences.

On pulpo.baby, Pulpo Eight and Le Pulpo Fat are optional auto-renewing monthly subscriptions with higher usage limits and more file storage. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Service: https://help.pulpo.baby/terms-hosted
Privacy Policy: https://help.pulpo.baby/privacy-hosted
en-US.promoText: A fast, native way to use your Pulpo AI workspace on iPhone.
